ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels; high macro-level contrast localized at the distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottling and streaking concentrated in the distal-lateral regions of both lobes, radiating inwards. Central region near the peduncle and median notch is predominantly low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with an estimated internal angle of 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations; left lobe exhibits ~10 distinct peaks; right lobe contains a significant cluster of 5-7 sharp, jagged peaks near the outer tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature along the posterior boundary, sweeping from the median notch to the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, circular high-contrast white spots (approx. 5-15 pixels in diameter) scattered across the dark central pigmented areas.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of fine, high-intensity linear marks (rake-like patterns) visible crossing the low-intensity regions, particularly on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, brownish-grey irregular protrusion/mass is attached to the extreme distal tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The right distal margin displays exceptionally high-amplitude, jagged topographic variation compared to the left margin.
